name: FLUX Schnell
description: Self-contained FLUX Schnell model extension scaffold for local text-to-image workflows.
author: DrHepa

params_schema.label: Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Prompt text for FLUX Schnell text-to-image generation.

params_schema.label: Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Recommended range is 1-4 for FLUX Schnell; higher values are experimental and may not improve quality.

params_schema.label: Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: FLUX Schnell uses guidance 0.0; non-zero guidance requires true CFG support.

params_schema.label: Max Sequence Length
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum FLUX text token sequence length passed to Diffusers.

params_schema.label: Output Format
params_schema.tooltip: File format for generated images. PNG preserves existing behavior; JPEG supports output_quality.

params_schema.label: JPEG Quality
params_schema.tooltip: JPEG quality from 1 to 100. Only valid when output_format is jpeg.
